payload.name: Southern Route Preference
payload.fact: Working memory load increases the application of the southern route preference heuristic during spatial decision making.
payload.boundary: Applies to route planning from maps.

provenance.title: Cognitive load during route selection increases reliance on spatial heuristics
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results replicated earlier results demonstrating a southern route preference (Experiment 1) and initial segment strategy (Experiment 2) and further demonstrated that evidence for heuristic reliance is more likely under conditions of concurrent working memory load
